title: Phil's Extravaganzza
description: This is a Vanilla+ modpack I made for a streamer friend.
body:
## Overview 
This is a modpack I made for a friend of mine.  It is a Vanilla+ modpack that adds some features to make the world and overall expeierence look better.  

## FEATURES

This modpack enhances the vanilla feel by adding shaders, a modifieable hud, dynamic lighting, and the ability to extend render distance beyond the normal limit.  The shaders allow for spectacular views of sunsets, the night sky, and even when you are caving.  LambDynamicLights gives the ability to toss a torch down a cavern and still be able to see the torch lit.

## Modlist
Some mods that have been added are listed below:

AppleSkin
Better Experience
Complimentary Unbound
FallingTree
Freecam
LambDynamicLights
Zoomify
And a few others...
